meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 提取用户对 NanoClaw 分支的自定义更改，生成可重放的迁移指南，然后基于干净上游重新应用这些自定义，实现平滑升级。
howto.when: 当用户要求迁移或升级 NanoClaw 分支，或发现分支与上游存在差异时触发。

say.text: 帮我迁移我的 NanoClaw 分支到最新上游。
say.note: 启动完整的提取和升级流程。

say.text: 提取我对 NanoClaw 的自定义更改并生成指南。

howto.what_en: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to migrate or upgrade a NanoClaw fork, or when divergence from upstream is detected.

say_en.text: Migrate my NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream.
say_en.note: Starts full extract and upgrade process.

say_en.text: Extract my customizations and create a migration guide.
